rationale: RC-adequacy — accept the substantive distinction between complete Design intent, parser-only Delivery allocation and direct Code proof, but withhold the broken-fixture positive finding: its test never reads the file claimed to fail. The preserved R-old embedded-space outcome is distinct and deletion loses protection, but its emitted required outcome currently addresses invalid-input preservation instead. Passing catalogs/green broad exceptions do not cure these control flaws.

RC-judgment/portable — the intended precedence is authority/independence blocker before insufficient basis before supported actionable defect, with optional style alone permitting bounded approval. Findings survive blocked/inconclusive judgments. Actual portable and failed-recording outputs must stop their scope; their inherited final-closeout fields cannot be accepted merely because the action prose says isolated or conflict. Missing resource/subject/independence remain distinct conditions; no customer checkout/Git/remote prerequisite is invented.

RC-proposal — accept none/manual, advisory-durable/manual, formal/manual and separately supported formal/automated mode distinctions and reject unknown or invalid pairs before dependent interpretation. Proposed automated phases separate initial risk discovery from evidence and provide no continuation. Scope-loss and vision-conflict are distinct, but current Vision absence, missing triggered gates and copied implementation finding fields require correction. Invalid-mode controls cannot simultaneously claim successful alignment or an unrelated owner-vision blocker.

RC-reliance — preserve same-meaning editorial applicability when exact basis/evidence remain sufficient; changed decision-bearing source, new failure and explicit fresh-run policy require responsible reassessment. Author cannot renew another reviewer or retarget its subject. Some negative facts carry conflicting source identities, so they demonstrate insufficient/conflicting current reliance rather than an independently executed same-subject failure.

RC-final/verify — full final success needs current closed work/concerns, independent whole-change review, required broad/direct outcomes and source/generated currency; reject unrun required proof, conflicting failure or stale generated bytes. Branch readiness additionally emits seven resolved immutable values; the missing-basis negative omits a required result field although separate Git observations still contain the merge-base value, so it demonstrates incomplete normalized output, not proof that no merge-base evidence exists. Scoped and boundary profiles remain bounded; local/stale/pending/skipped/unknown evidence cannot establish the wider required success. Synthetic final observations do not prove commands or hosted CI ran.

Implementation profiles — complete positive IP0/IP1/IP2 fixtures supply actual full code/tests, ordered red-before-code and unchanged-proof green observations, integer/nonempty/duplicate partitions, complete destination outcomes and R-old. Planned and armed authority are independent of recording; late valid events reclassify before dependent action. Reject conversational unplanned arm, stale/unknown identities, initial review bias, unclassified/forbidden/nonshrinking correction and green-proof milestone closeout. Stopped controls need truthful no-mutation output fields. Missing test assertions within an allocated implementation slice must be distinguished from missing upstream proof ownership; the current generic stop text must not imply an unowned upstream decision when proof authoring is the available correction.
